text: Evening. I'm a foster carer and have an 8 year old girl staying with me. Temperature this evening is 38°C. While getting her ready for bed I noticed some small dark reddish-purple spots on her tummy and the backs of her legs. I pressed the side of a glass against them as I've been taught, and they did not fade at all, still clearly visible through the glass. I'd like advice on next steps please.
